page: Amazon Web Services i7i.4xlarge is a storage-optimized server powered by an Intel Xeon 8559C processor. It features 16 vCPUs across 8 physical cores with hyper-threading enabled, operating at a clock speed of 3.2 GHz. The CPU architecture is x86_64, supported by a 320 MB L3 cache. Memory configuration includes 128.0 GB of DDR5 RAM operating at 6 GHz, providing 8.0 GB of memory per core.

This instance type includes 3750 GB of local NVMe SSD storage, making it highly suitable for data-intensive operations. It runs on the Nitro hypervisor and delivers a baseline network bandwidth of 9 Gbps. There are no GPUs or complimentary public IPv4 addresses bundled with this instance.

In benchmark testing, the i7i.4xlarge demonstrates strong single-core capabilities, with a Geekbench single-core score of 2308.0 and a text processing score of 2840.0, both placing in the top 10%. Memory write performance is also notable, with large block write speeds reaching 91.67 GB/sec (top 25%). Single-threaded gzip compression performs at 34.75 GB/sec. Multi-core performance, Redis SET operations, and medium-to-large LLM inference speeds generally align with mid-tier averages.

Given its high local NVMe SSD capacity and DDR5 memory density, the i7i.4xlarge offers qualitative cost efficiency for workloads requiring high-speed local storage and significant memory per core without the overhead of external storage attachments. It is well-suited for relational and non-relational databases, text processing pipelines, caching layers, and lightweight LLM inference tasks.
